sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Ceasefire signed with last rebel group
geopolitical_news.summary: September's deal with the FNL aims to end Burundi's 13-year civil war.

geopolitical_news.headline: Post-war reconstruction begins
geopolitical_news.summary: The government demobilizes fighters and rebuilds institutions after the Arusha accords.

sport.headline: Burundi fall short in AFCON qualifying
sport.summary: The Swallows miss out on the 2008 Africa Cup of Nations.

geopolitical_news.headline: FNL ceasefire collapses
geopolitical_news.summary: Fighting resumes around Bujumbura as the last rebel group abandons the truce.

geopolitical_news.headline: Political tensions rise
geopolitical_news.summary: Opposition accuses President Nkurunziza's party of authoritarian drift.

sport.headline: Burundi miss 2008 AFCON
sport.summary: The Swallows fail to qualify for the Ghana tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: FNL attacks the capital
geopolitical_news.summary: April rebel shelling of Bujumbura kills civilians and shatters the ceasefire.

geopolitical_news.headline: Regional mediation resumes
geopolitical_news.summary: Tanzania and South Africa push the FNL back to negotiations.

sport.headline: Burundi compete at Beijing Olympics
sport.summary: Burundian athletes take part in the 2008 Games.

geopolitical_news.headline: FNL disarms and becomes a party
geopolitical_news.summary: The last rebel movement lays down arms in April and registers as a political party.

geopolitical_news.headline: Civil war formally ends
geopolitical_news.summary: With the FNL demobilized, Burundi's 16-year conflict is declared over.

sport.headline: Burundi chase 2010 World Cup spot
sport.summary: The Swallows stay in contention early in qualifying for South Africa 2010.

geopolitical_news.headline: Nkurunziza re-elected amid boycott
geopolitical_news.summary: The president wins June's vote unopposed after rivals withdraw alleging intimidation.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition leaders flee
geopolitical_news.summary: Key rivals go into exile as post-election repression intensifies.

sport.headline: Burundi miss 2010 World Cup
sport.summary: The Swallows fall short in qualifying for South Africa 2010.

geopolitical_news.headline: Political violence resurges
geopolitical_news.summary: Grenade attacks and assassinations target opposition figures in Bujumbura.

geopolitical_news.headline: Government denies crackdown
geopolitical_news.summary: Authorities reject UN criticism of extrajudicial killings.

sport.headline: Burundi miss 2012 AFCON
sport.summary: The Swallows fail to qualify for the Gabon-Equatorial Guinea tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Burundi sends troops to Somalia
geopolitical_news.summary: Burundian soldiers join AMISOM's fight against al-Shabaab.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition regroups in exile
geopolitical_news.summary: Exiled leaders form coalitions to challenge Nkurunziza's rule.

sport.headline: Burundi compete at London Olympics
sport.summary: Burundian athletes take part in the 2012 Games.

geopolitical_news.headline: UN warns of political tensions
geopolitical_news.summary: Envoys caution that Nkurunziza may seek a disputed third term in 2015.

geopolitical_news.headline: Media crackdown intensifies
geopolitical_news.summary: Independent radio stations face harassment and closures.

sport.headline: Burundi miss 2013 AFCON
sport.summary: The Swallows fail to reach the South Africa tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ruling party backs third term bid
geopolitical_news.summary: The CNDD-FDD endorses Nkurunziza for 2015 despite constitutional term limits.

geopolitical_news.headline: Protests simmer in Bujumbura
geopolitical_news.summary: Youth demonstrations against a third term are broken up by police.

sport.headline: Burundi miss 2014 World Cup
sport.summary: The Swallows fall short in qualifying for Brazil 2014.

geopolitical_news.headline: Nkurunziza seeks third term, crisis erupts
geopolitical_news.summary: April's announcement triggers mass protests and a violent crackdown killing hundreds.

geopolitical_news.headline: Coup attempt fails
geopolitical_news.summary: General Niyombare's May putsch collapses while Nkurunziza is abroad.

geopolitical_news.headline: Nkurunziza wins disputed election
geopolitical_news.summary: July's vote, boycotted by rivals, extends his rule as refugees flee.

sport.headline: Burundi miss 2015 AFCON
sport.summary: The Swallows fail to qualify for the Equatorial Guinea tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Violence continues after failed coup
geopolitical_news.summary: Assassinations and disappearances persist as the regime targets dissenters.

geopolitical_news.headline: African Union peacekeepers rejected
geopolitical_news.summary: Bujumbura refuses an AU protection force despite regional pressure.

sport.headline: Burundi compete at Rio Olympics
sport.summary: Burundian athletes take part in the Rio 2016 Games.

geopolitical_news.headline: Burundi quits International Criminal Court
geopolitical_news.summary: Bujumbura becomes the first country to withdraw from the ICC in October.

geopolitical_news.headline: Refugee exodus continues
geopolitical_news.summary: Hundreds of thousands remain in camps in Tanzania and Rwanda.

sport.headline: Burundi miss 2017 AFCON
sport.summary: The Swallows fail to reach the Gabon tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Referendum extends presidential terms
geopolitical_news.summary: May's vote could let Nkurunziza rule until 2034; the opposition calls it a sham.

geopolitical_news.headline: Border attack kills dozens
geopolitical_news.summary: A May raid near the DRC frontier heightens regional tensions.

sport.headline: Burundi miss 2018 World Cup
sport.summary: The Swallows fall short in qualifying for Russia 2018.

geopolitical_news.headline: Nkurunziza named 'supreme guide'
geopolitical_news.summary: Parliament grants the president an exalted title as succession speculation grows.

geopolitical_news.headline: UN human rights investigators expelled
geopolitical_news.summary: Bujumbura shuts the UN rights office in a defiant move.

sport.headline: Burundi debut at AFCON
sport.summary: The Swallows reach their first Africa Cup of Nations in Egypt, exiting at the group stage.

geopolitical_news.headline: Nkurunziza dies suddenly
geopolitical_news.summary: The president dies of reported cardiac arrest in June, days after his chosen successor wins election.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ndayishimiye takes power
geopolitical_news.summary: General Evariste Ndayishimiye is inaugurated in June, pledging reconciliation.

sport.headline: Football suspended by pandemic
sport.summary: Burundi's leagues halt for months amid COVID-19.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ndayishimiye consolidates power
geopolitical_news.summary: The new president purges Nkurunziza-era hardliners while keeping tight control.

geopolitical_news.headline: Sanctions pressure eases
geopolitical_news.summary: The EU resumes dialogue as Bujumbura makes modest reforms.

sport.headline: Burundi miss 2021 AFCON
sport.summary: The Swallows fail to build on their 2019 debut, missing the Cameroon tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: EU lifts sanctions
geopolitical_news.summary: Brussels resumes direct aid in February after years of suspension.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rwanda tensions flare
geopolitical_news.summary: Bujumbura accuses Kigali of backing rebels along their shared border.

sport.headline: Burundi miss 2022 World Cup
sport.summary: The Swallows fall short in qualifying for Qatar 2022.

geopolitical_news.headline: Burundi closes border with Rwanda
geopolitical_news.summary: January's shutdown escalates a long-running feud over rebel support.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ndayishimiye hosts regional talks
geopolitical_news.summary: Bujumbura positions itself in Great Lakes diplomacy.

sport.headline: Burundi miss 2023 AFCON
sport.summary: The Swallows fail to qualify for the Ivory Coast tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rwanda border stays shut
geopolitical_news.summary: The frontier remains closed as both sides trade accusations over armed groups.

geopolitical_news.headline: Burundi deploys troops to eastern DRC
geopolitical_news.summary: Burundian soldiers fight alongside Congolese forces against M23 rebels.

sport.headline: Burundi chase 2026 World Cup spot
sport.summary: The Swallows stay in contention in qualifying for the expanded 2026 tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ruling party wins legislative elections
geopolitical_news.summary: June's vote extends CNDD-FDD dominance amid opposition complaints.

geopolitical_news.headline: DRC conflict spills toward Burundi
geopolitical_news.summary: M23 advances near the border raise fears of regional escalation.

sport.headline: Burundi qualify for 2025 AFCON
sport.summary: The Swallows reach the Morocco tournament, their second AFCON appearance.
